text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts observed for customer 'novahealth' on Dedicated pool novahealth-prod. Alert threshold breached (5m error rate > 8%).

alex chen: seeing 502/504s from the gateway and spikes of 5xx in the tenant kube-proxy logs. Can someone grab p95 latency and recent evictions?

priya rao: i'm on it. pulling metrics now — p95 token latency up from 120ms to 600ms for this tenant. error spikes correlate with a handful of GPU nodes showing high memory pressure.

dmitri kozlov: adding logs from the serving proxy: ``ERROR downstream: upstream connection reset by peer`` repeated across ~10k requests/min. There are also OOMKilled events on one of the model-worker pods.

sasha wang: looks like a noisy neighbor — a single tenant job launched large-batch offline eval on the same pool around 02:10 UTC. It pushed GPU memory to 95% and caused evictions.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1052. Severity: P1. Pager assigned: alex chen. Channel: #incidents.

alex chen: immediate plan: 1) isolate novahealth traffic to fallback pool 2) scale up dedicated pool capacity (if available) 3) throttle large-batch jobs.

priya rao: starting with mitigation (1) — routing rule update to prefer fallback-variant model in a different nodepool. Applying routing override for novahealth: ``route set --tenant novahealth --prefer pool:folkstone-fallback``

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by priya rao: routing override novahealth -> folkstone-fallback (id: deploy_1978712350).

alex chen: good. while that rolls, dmitri can you confirm whether autoscaler can add nodes to novahealth-prod? I see reserved capacity almost exhausted.

dmitri kozlov: autoscaler report: reserved capacity used 98%, cloud quota allows +2 nodes in region us-west2. I'll request scale up.

priya rao: routing override is live. early signs: gateway 5xx count dropping but still noisy for active streams. New traffic is getting routed to fallback pool. :small_blue_diamond:

csm lee: i've pinged NovaHealth on the support thread — they're seeing failures in production UX. They want ETA for full recovery.

alex chen: ETA: risk-reduction now (routing) -> minutes. Full recovery depends on autoscaler and eviction mitigation, ~20-30m. I'll post updates every 5m.

dmitri kozlov: scaling up cluster: requesting 2 nodes. Cloud API responded with async job id cjob-9812. Nodes should be ready in ~12m.

sasha wang: meanwhile i've identified the runaway batch job: job id batch-eval-7932 belongs to internal research tenant 'sprint-labs'. It's using massive batch_size and pinned to same pool. I'm pausing it now.

sasha wang: ``kubectl annotate job batch-eval-7932 pause=true --namespace research`` -> paused. Confirmed. GPU memory usage on affected nodes dropping to 60-70%.

priya rao: after pause, we see dropping evictions. gateway 5xx rate decreased by ~65% in last 3m. :thumbsup:

alex chen: awesome. keep monitoring. dmitri proceed with node add but reduce autoscaler thresholds so we have buffer. Change: target utilization from 85% -> 70% for novahealth-prod pool.

dmitri kozlov: updated autoscaler config: ``util_target: 70`` and bumped max nodes +2. Applying... done.

deploy-bot: autoscaler config applied by dmitri kozlov (id: deploy_1978712381).

priya rao: novahealth error rate now back under threshold (3m avg < 2%). Streaming sessions that were mid-flight still show a few timeouts but most requests succeed.

alex chen: can we run a short canary to ensure model outputs are stable on fallback pool? Run 50 requests against fallback model variant.

priya rao: running canary script: ``scripts/canary_run.sh --tenant novahealth --count 50``. Results: 49/50 success, median latency 210ms. One failure was an earlier stream that got drained.

csm lee: relaying update to NovaHealth: mitigation applied (traffic reroute + paused runaway job). Requesting customer to resume at low ramp.

sasha wang: follow-up: adding node isolation policy to prevent batch-eval from landing on tenant pools. I'll create an admission webhook that denies large GPU requests in shared pools.

alex chen: good long-term fix. For now: 1) keep routing override for 30m 2) keep autoscaler target lowered 3) leave batch job paused and notify research.

priya rao: creating post-incident checklist and timeline. I'll capture metrics and make a graph for the weekly postmortem.

dmitri kozlov: nodes are up. Novahealth traffic gradually migrates back to primary pool with safe headroom.

oncall-bot: Pager duty: incident INC-2026-1052 acknowledged by alex chen.

alex chen: closing loop: error rates stable, no customer errors for 10m. I'm going to mark the incident as mitigated. We'll run a short postmortem with infra + ML + product. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

priya rao: note for postmortem: root cause = noisy neighbor batch eval on shared nodepool + autoscaler target too tight. Action items: isolate batch workloads, admission policy, autoscaler tuning, CSM communication template.

csm lee: NovaHealth accepted mitigation and will do a slow resume tomorrow. I'll coordinate SLA credits if necessary.

alex chen: logging the incident and following up with a write-up. Closing channel but leaving pinned notes for postmortem.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-1052 status updated -> mitigated (P1 -> mitigated).
